profile.headline: Software Engineer at Qualtrics
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Created a loader task in an ETL (Extract,Transfer,Load) system that bulk updates thousands of objects

- Utilized Typescript to implement an App Framework Extension, achieved 85%+ unit test coverage using Jest

- Learned Golang to build a backend module that performs consecutive requests to an internal API.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Gitlab · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Jest

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Redesigned over 10+ dashboards using multiple React libraries and CSS styling

- Developed a skills recommended graph with over 100 relationships between skills and titles

- Created schemas and queries with Graphql to call external API endpoints and use on the frontend

- Tested and re-wrote SQL queries on the backend using Snowflake
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · GraphQL

positions.title: Associate Trainer/ Team Lead
positions.description:
- Trained over 10+ new workers in food preparation, and in service, sanitation, and safety procedures.

- Completed over 100+ catering orders and ensured all catered events were consistently prepared and served according to recipes, portioning, and serving standards
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Team Leadership · Customer Service

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
- Developed robust web applications with React, a Javascript framework

-Tracked changes and collaborate with team members with GitHub

- Created projects such as a personal website, dashboard, weather app, using APIs and open source packages

- Learned several languages including Javascript, HTML, and CSS

positions.title: Makerspace Technology Fellow
positions.description:
- Trained on a variety of technologies, such as 3D Modeling, 3D Printing, AR/VR and app prototyping

- Designed a prototype of an app called “Hoo’s Studying” to help UVa students search for an ideal study space based on their personal preferences. 

- Created a 3D Printing itinerary for a Girl Scout Maker Camp, intended to host 15+ middle school girls and introduce them to STEM and makerspace technology
positions.insights: Skills: Autodesk Inventor · 3D Printing · Augmented Reality (AR) · Virtual Reality (VR)

volunteerExperiences.description:
Refurbished over 50+ computers by replacing hardware components and testing and downloading software onto them.
Distributed refurbished computers along with mouses, keyboards, and monitors to over 50+ low-income families in the local community and translated to Hispanic families on how to use and setup their new computer.

Planned dorm tours and scavenger hunt for over 50 prospective students on High School Visitation Day.
Led 15+ students on a tour of the first-year dorm buildings and gave advice on classes and housing
